verses.text: Brothers and sisters, when I came to you, I did not come with fine speeches or great wisdom as I told you God's message.
I decided that while I was with you, I would think about nothing except Jesus Christ and his death on the cross.
I came to you weak, afraid and trembling.
My words and my preaching did not use clever human wisdom to win you over. Instead, they showed the power of the Spirit.
I did this so that your faith would not rest on human wisdom, but on the power of God.
But we do speak wisdom among those who are grown up in faith. It is not the wisdom of this world, or of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing.
We speak God's hidden wisdom, his secret plan. Before time began, God planned it for our glory.
None of the rulers of this world understood it. If they had, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
But as the Scriptures say, "No eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no mind has imagined what God has prepared for those who love him."
But God has shown these things to us through his Spirit. The Spirit searches everything, even the deep things of God.
Who can know a person's thoughts except that person's own spirit inside them? In the same way, no one knows God's thoughts except God's Spirit.
We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who comes from God. So we can understand what God has freely given us.
We speak about these things with words taught by the Spirit, not by human wisdom. We explain spiritual truths with spiritual words.
A person without the Spirit does not accept the things that come from God's Spirit. They seem foolish to them. They cannot understand them, because only the Spirit can help us understand them.
The person who has the Spirit can judge all things, but no one can judge that person.
The Scriptures ask, "Who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to teach him?" But we have the mind of Christ.
